'''Jodi''' was an [[Jodi's species|alien]] who attended the three-[[Local day|day]] [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]] in [[4 BBY]]. During the first [[Standard day|day]], they chatted with another [[Letrun Pay's species|alien]] near the estate's landing pad and later attended a party where [[Davo Sculdun]], [[Parent|father]] of the groom, spoke with them. On the third day, Jodi watched Davo unveil a [[Chandi Merle]] he was gifting the newlyweds, then watched the couple's first dance, before dancing and singing to the [[Music|song]] "[[Niamos!]]."

==Biography==
===A Chandi wedding===
Jodi was an [[Jodi's species|alien]] who was invited to the three-[[Local day|day]] [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on<ref name="OYL" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|chandrila|Chandrila}}</ref> [[Chandrila]] in [[4 BBY]]. On the first [[Standard day|day]], Jodi stood conversing with another [[Letrun Pay's species|alien]] guest atop the steps down to one of the estate's landing pads as the [[Gender|bride's]] [[parent]]s, [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] and [[Perrin Fertha]], greeted Fertha's aunt [[Squidna]] and uncle [[Sordo]] as they arrived by [[airspeeder]].<ref name="OYL" />

[[File:Jodi-Davo-OneYearLater.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Davo Sculdun grips Jodi's hand in a courtyard of the Mothma Estate as other guests mingle nearby.|Jodi spoke with Davo Sculdun during the latter's son's wedding.]]
At a party inside one of the estate's small courtyards<ref name="OYLAD">{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> later that night, Jodi spoke with two [[human]]s<ref name="OYL" /> as other guests mingled over cocktails. While making the rounds,<ref name="OYLAD" /> [[Davo Sculdun]], the [[Sculdun family|father]] of the groom, approached Jodi and grasped the [[alien]]'s [[Limb|hand]], getting their attention to tell them that something was done. Jodi acknowledged this before turning back to the two humans.<ref name="OYL" />

===First dance, all dance===
{{Quote|Niamos!|Jodi and other guests cry out during a song|audio=Niamos-Harvest.flac|<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>}}
On the third day of the wedding, after the ceremony, Jodi was part of a crowd that gathered in the estate ballroom to watch Davo unveil his gift to the newlyweds. The alien stood directly behind the [[antiques dealer]] [[Luthen Rael]] as Davo pulled away a cloth to reveal a [[Chandi Merle]], explaining the temple figure's provenance and introducing Rael to the crowd as the man who helped him acquire the gift.<ref name="Harvest" />

[[File:FirstDance-Harvest.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Leida Mothma and Stekan Sculdun dance traditionally in the center of a ballroom as a crowd of wedding guests stand circled around them. A three-piece band plays music to one side.|Jodi watched the first dance of Leida Mothma and Stekan Sculdun.]]
The guests then mingled around the statue, with Jodi talking to two humans near a [[Viewport|window]] until an announcer asked the guests to clear the ballroom's dance floor as the Chandi Merle was wheeled away. Jodi formed a circle round the dance floor with the other guests to watch Stekan and Leida in their first dance. After more mingling, a [[speaker droid]] entered the room and began playing [[music]] for the guests to all dance to. During the song "[[Niamos!]]," Jodi raised their hands and cried out the name of the song at its climax along with the other guests.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Personality and traits==
Jodi had [[Color|gray]] and brown skin and dark [[eye]]s.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Equipment==
On the first day of the wedding, Jodi wore lavender [[robe]]s with white [[Clothing|shoes]] and a silver [[necklace]] with a large series of concentric circles hanging over their chest.<ref name="OYL" /> On the third day, the alien wore a deep blue robe with a silver shawl over it, as well as white shoes, the same silver necklace as the first day, and an additional lower-hanging necklace of white spheres.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JodiMold-Instagram.jpg|thumb|right|300px|alt=A photo of the tan mold of Jodi's head made by Robert Skene.|Robert Skene created a mold of Jodi.]]
Jodi first appeared in "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Harvest]]," the first and third episodes of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="OYL" /> both of which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> [[Ivan Manzella]] created concept art of Jodi<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> and [[Justin Pitkethly]] sculpted the character, which [[Robert Skene]] then used to make a five-part fiberglass mold of Jodi's mask as part of work done for [[Neal Scanlan]]'s creature shop, with [[Kenny Wilson]] as Moldshop HOD.<ref name="robskene-Instagram">{{Instagram|username=robskenefx|url=p/DN_hyidEeMZ|name=[[Robert Skene]]|date=2025-08-30|quote=I made a 5 part fiberglass mold of this character, sculpted by @justinpitkethly. They show up multiple times over the season, at the wedding, Sculden's party and in the senate building, always in crowds in the background though. All work done for Neal Scanlan's creature shop, with Kenny Wilson as Moldshop HOD.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/5EOZR|archivefile=File:RobertSkene-Jodi-Instagram.png|archivefile2=File:RobertSkene-Jodi2-Instagram.png}}</ref> The scene in which Jodi first appears<ref name="OYL" /> was filmed as a "oner" and was the final visual effects shot filmed for the season, completed in collaboration between [[Industrial Light & Magic]] and [[Scanline VFX]] on [[August 5]], [[2024]].<ref name="Declassified">{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}}</ref>
